source: make a game player spawns in Zig zag trench with a tool Rifle Lee-Enfield weapon makes 25 damage and an NPC front of player for testing shooting.

image_prompt.text: The spawn sunk inside the trench itself, the trench walls breaking every sightline into it
A zigzag trench cut into the ground - a narrow sunken channel that turns sharply left and right along its length

layout_placement.text: Player spawn at the mouth of the trench, holding the rifle
A stationary NPC standing directly in front of the player, in line of sight, as a shooting test target

notes: No preset was taken: every Shooter preset describes a competitive or wave-based match, and this is a one-player test scene with a single dummy.
A zigzag trench is one winding channel, not parallel lanes. lane-network is the nearest of the three shapes and is a poor fit - the trench traverses are the only thing making it lane-like.
Rifle damage of 25 is a weapon stat with no layout consequence.

open_questions.ask: How long should the trench run - a short test stretch, or a full trench line to move along?
The Lee-Enfield implies a WWI setting - should the trench be built as period earthworks, or kept generic?

theme: WWI battlefield - earth trench walls, timber revetment, khaki military kit

coverage_missing.ask: Period WWI earthworks, or generic trench?
Is this a test scene, or should the trench become a real map with enemies?

answers.ask: How long should the trench run - a short test stretch, or a full trench line to move along?
answers.answer: Use a short test stretch of zig-zag trench; this is a small shooting test area.

answers.ask: The Lee-Enfield implies a WWI setting - should the trench be built as period earthworks, or kept generic?
answers.answer: Build it as WWI-style period earthworks to match the Lee-Enfield.
